01 / About us

Curiosity meets application.

IIS Lab is a research group at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University led by Dr. Ming Li. We explore how intelligent technologies can enable secure information sharing, smarter industrial systems, and more capable AI agents.

We believe research should go beyond abstract concepts. Our work connects fundamental ideas with practical problems, while our collaborative culture makes room for curiosity, experimentation, and life outside the lab.

OUR VISIONIntelligent systems that connect ideas with real-world impact.Advancing trustworthy collaboration, adaptive industry, and practical AI.
02 / Research directions

Blockchain

Secure multi-party information sharing, on-chain/off-chain collaborative computing, and service-oriented blockchain systems.

Cyber-Physical Systems

Cyber-physical workbenches for garment production and assembly, multimodal workers, and programmable manufacturing systems.

LLMs & AI Agents

Domain-specific AI agents, research and retrieval assistants, and language models for operations research and optimization.

Meet our people

The people behind IIS Lab

IIS Lab is a collaborative research community led by Ir Dr. Ming Li at The Hong Kong Polytechnic University.
